r7.label: Gateway
r7.tagline: The gateway that remembers every request.
r7.summary: Routes traffic to your services and records every exchange — metadata, headers or full bodies — to memory-mapped files on local disk, with secrets stored only as fingerprints. Configuration is checked before it serves a single request.
r7.stack: Java · Helidon Níma · WARC · JSON lines

clearsky.title: Clearsky
clearsky.label: Developer tool
clearsky.tagline: One local page for what needs you at work.
clearsky.summary: Reviews, PRs, Jira tickets, mentions, today's meetings and a stand-up summary — with a sandboxed Copilot chat beside it. Runs on your own machine with your own logins, and keeps nothing anywhere else.
clearsky.stack: Node · GitHub CLI · Atlassian CLI · Plugins
